Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on the recording, if that's okay. You have my claim number.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was driving through an intersection in Katy, Texas. I had a green light, heading straight through.
Q: What happened as you entered the intersection?
A: A vehicle coming from my right ran the red light and hit the driver's side of my car. I didn't see it until it was almost
on me. I tried to brake but three wasn't time.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was. The airbag on my side did deploy, and I was thrown against the door.
Q: Did you get checked out after the accident?
A: The paramedics looked at me at the scene, and then I went to the emergency room that evening. They said my
right shoulder was strained and I had some bruising along my ribs.
Q: Are you still having symptoms?
A: Yes. I can't lift my arm above my shoulder without pain, and I'm doing physical therapy twice a week. I've had to
take time off work because I can't drive long distances or lift anything heavy.
Q: Did you have any prior problems with that shoulder?
A: No, not that I can recall. It was fine before this.
Q: Is there anything else you think I should know?
A: Just that the other driver admitted at the scene that they didn't see the light. I'd like this claim handled as quickly as
possible.
Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
</page>

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
